facts: An explicit cause is set when an exception is raised with `raise ... from ...`.
An implicit context is set when an exception is raised while handling another exception.
A suppressed context is not reported when `suppress_context` is true.
fact_paraphrases: Raising with `raise ... from ...` records an explicit `__cause__`.
The `__cause__` link is explicit when the raise statement uses `from`.
Raising while handling another exception records an implicit `__context__`.
The `__context__` link is implicit and set during handling of another exception.
When `suppress_context` is true the implicit context is not reported.
A suppressed context is omitted from the report.
